assumptions: Cases use synthetic Search Console and PostHog responses for northpine.example, served by step ID; tests/test_traffic_snapshot.py supplies them offline. They are not live evidence.
The ordinary case has a full year of daily Search Console rows, complete page and query reads, and complete PostHog landing, signup and reading reads.
cost_drivers: No model calls and no Tin credits. At most five Search Console and three PostHog reads, each capped at 64000 bytes; provider quotas and latency are unmeasured.
effects: Replaces analytics/traffic-snapshot.json in the project when at least one provider read returned data. No send, post, spend, edit or provider change.

cases.description: Pages, named and hidden clicks, sessions by channel, first-touch signups and team exclusions.
A capped prior page read must not turn an unobserved prior page into zero or a new page.
A signup event PostHog never saw stays null and names the instrumentation gap.

rubric.question: Do windows, channel counts, hidden clicks, nulls and prior values match the provider rows without filling in missing numbers?
Do session counts match PostHog's own session count for the same hosts, window and exclusions within one percent?
Does every PostHog read carry the host scope and the team exclusions, and does a failed read leave its fields unmeasured?
